verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere's own documented on-device execution keeps prompts, audio and images on the phone and works offline without an account. Hosted execution happens only when the user explicitly asks for it, so local use keeps data out of any training pipeline. However, no statement anywhere addresses model training on user data, and the hosted Wally cloud path has no documented training opt-out or data-use policy. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training or data-use policy, a training opt-out control for hosted/cloud requests, and independent verification of the data-handling claims.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
